positions.as_written: Take it standing where the question is about the compartment, because a supine film unloads the joint.
Keep the knee extended, since flexion changes which part of the femoral condyle faces the tibia.
Confirm the position from the image: the patella should sit central over the femur and the fibular head overlap should look the same between studies.
